_doc: The volcanic (hellish plains) special sites (bead bzc.125, docs/art/classes/map-objects.md, docs/design/CONTENT_MAP_OBJECTS.md 3.14): the Infernal Forge and the Brimstone Pit (2x2 on 128 x 128) and the Shrine of Embers (1x1 on 64 x 64). generate-image-v2 at native display size; the roadside inn (map-objects/inn-a#0) is the style image for the chunky rounded shapes, outline, pixel size and viewing angle only, as the chunky towns and the sawmill of bead bzc.97. Layers: style, light-south-west, class-map-object, subject. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

styleInn.usage: copy only the thick black outline, the pixel size, the chunky rounded shapes, the flat shading with one shadow tone and the slightly-from-above front viewing angle; not the subject, not the colours and not the layout

recipes.subject: Subject: a cute chunky infernal forge of a volcanic plain: a plump squat smithy of rounded black basalt blocks #3a3036 with #241c22 shadows under a dark iron roof #4a4050 with two curved red horns #b03a2a on its ridge, a fat round chimney at the back with orange embers on top, a huge round furnace mouth glowing bright orange and yellow #f07a2a #ffc03a in the middle of its front, a big black iron anvil with a hammer on it at the front left, a little trough of glowing lava at the front right. Nearly the full image wide and most of its height, its front facing the viewer straight on.
recipes.negative: person, demon figure, smoke cloud, ground, grass, sky, text

recipes.subject: Subject: a brimstone pit, a guarded treasure bank: a chunky rounded mound of black volcanic rock #3a3036 crusted with yellow sulphur #e8d43a, a dark cave mouth in its front glowing orange #f07a2a from below, an iron chain across the cave mouth between two horned rock posts, a small treasure chest and sulphur crystals at the front left. Each image a different size of it: a small modest one, a medium one, a large grand one, and another large grand one. Nearly the full image wide and most of its height, its front facing the viewer.
recipes.negative: person, demon figure, skeleton figure, smoke cloud, ground, grass, sky, text

recipes.subject: Subject: a small shrine of embers on a volcanic plain: a squat rounded altar of black basalt #3a3036 with #241c22 shadows, a wide iron brazier on top full of glowing orange and yellow coals #f07a2a #ffc03a with a little tongue of flame, a carved red horned sigil #b03a2a on its front face, two short black stone horns at its corners. Each image a slightly different shrine. About three quarters of the image wide and nearly the full image tall, its front facing the viewer straight on.
recipes.negative: person, demon figure, smoke cloud, ground, grass, sky, text
